title: Tasmi' sheet with the rubric
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Seeded from quran/y8 lesson 46 (Pupil PDF worksheet: tasmi' sheet with the rubric)
intro: Lesson 46: Tasmi' in pairs: Nuh with the rubric. To understand how to listen to a partner's recitation of Nuh against the rubric and give exact, kind feedback

questions.q: Teacher and a volunteer model one tasmi' round on 71:1 to 4.
questions.a: Volunteer recites; teacher marks and gives one exact tip.
questions.model: I do: I mark two criteria, then say a strength and an exact point.

questions.q: Breakout pairs: tasmi' of Nuh 1 to 28 with the rubric; write both tips in the portal log.
questions.a: Each pupil has rubric marks and an exact tip.
questions.model: The teacher joins the first pair.

questions.q: recite again using your partner's tip.

questions.a: the word, the rule and the fix
options: the word, the rule and the fix

questions.q: Back to our ponder: What makes feedback on recitation useful rather than hurtful?
questions.a: It is kind, exact (word and rule) and given at the right moment, with a strength first.
